summary: An Etobicoke family dental office appears to lose new patients to placeholder testimonial text and a very long service menu.

findings.problem: The testimonials section appears to include placeholder Lorem ipsum text instead of real patient reviews.
findings.cost: Fake looking reviews cost trust exactly where a new patient is deciding.
findings.fix: Real patient reviews with names and ratings.

findings.problem: The menu appears to list more than 25 services and sub services in one long list.
findings.cost: Patients cannot find the service they came for and leave without booking.
findings.fix: Grouped service pages with a clear next step.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp or text option appears, only a phone number and an email.
findings.cost: Patients who want a quick answer message first, and the office that replies first gets the booking.
